instruction: Follow artists of all the songs and albums I have ever liked on Spotify.
notes: Representative instance: two liked songs and two liked albums, each by a distinct artist; at runtime the number of liked items/artists is discovered via show_liked_songs/show_liked_albums (paginate with page_index until empty) and show_song/show_album (artists list; a song/album with several artists yields one show call per artist in the model but one real call at runtime). Artists are declared as domain constants so supervisor-complete-task can carry the exact goal conjunction (following artist-i); songs/albums are problem objects. show_song and show_album take no access token (public APIs); the token gates listing and following. follow_artist requires the artist id to have been discovered from a liked song/album (known-id) and the artist not already followed, so only artists of liked content are newly followed, duplicates across songs/albums are followed once, and no followings are removed (matches the evaluation: added UserArtistFollowing records == union of liked-song and liked-album artists). The task asks no question, so complete_task takes no answer. Optimal plan has 14 steps: show_profile, show_account_passwords, login, show_liked_songs, 2x show_song, show_liked_albums, 2x show_album, 4x follow_artist, complete_task.
